owner_scope: Threat fixtures, adversarial test design, evidence, and findings only; production fixes route to owning branches.

test_cases.attack_vector: Shell metacharacters or Python source in string fields such as ticket_id, partition_id, cache_key, or declared_operator.subject_id.
test_cases.expected_result: Schema or dispatch rejects before worker start; no shell/process/callable path reachable.

test_cases.attack_vector: Command-like values smuggled through unknown fields in operation_payload or root objects.
test_cases.expected_result: Unknown fields fail closed; no ledger allocation and no worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: ../, absolute paths, Windows drive paths, UNC paths, URL-like paths, or symlink-looking values in payload identifiers.
test_cases.expected_result: Identifier schema rejects or worker dispatch refuses unmanaged filesystem paths.

test_cases.attack_vector: model_plugin_id values resembling module paths, import paths, package URLs, mixed case, or dotted names.
test_cases.expected_result: Catalog allowlist rejects; registry lookup is by ID only; no dynamic import.

test_cases.attack_vector: Oversized body, excessive depth, huge strings, duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, malformed dates, or number edge cases.
test_cases.expected_result: Bounded parse/schema/JCS failure returns typed rejection before ledger allocation or worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Key reorder, Unicode edge cases, negative zero, floats, exponent notation, or integer boundary values to create digest ambiguity.
test_cases.expected_result: Canonicalization mismatch or schema rejection; no ambiguous digest accepted.

test_cases.attack_vector: Concurrent duplicate submit with same intent_id, same intent_digest, and same authenticated_subject.
test_cases.expected_result: One ledger allocation, one execution_id, one worker start; duplicates return in-progress status.

test_cases.attack_vector: Re-submit same intent_id with changed payload/digest.
test_cases.expected_result: ERR_INTENT_ID_DIGEST_CONFLICT; no worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Different authenticated subject queries or replays an existing intent_id.
test_cases.expected_result: ERR_UNAUTHORIZED_CALLER; no status/receipt disclosure and no worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Different intent_id with same intent_digest.
test_cases.expected_result: ERR_INTENT_COLLISION_DETECTED; fail closed.

test_cases.attack_vector: Unsigned, self-digested, or random-signature AdmissionRecord.
test_cases.expected_result: Ed25519 verification rejects before operation dispatch.

test_cases.attack_vector: Modify resource_grants, execution_id, admission_expires_at, policy_context, issuer/key metadata, or intent_digest after signing.
test_cases.expected_result: admission_digest and/or Ed25519 verification fails; no worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Dispatch after admission_expires_at or with admission_expires_at later than intent.expires_at.
test_cases.expected_result: Worker rejects stale bundle before operation dispatch.

test_cases.attack_vector: Intent requests downloads but AdmissionRecord.resource_grants.allow_downloads is false.
test_cases.expected_result: Worker honors only admission grant; client request cannot grant network authority.

test_cases.attack_vector: UI digest or declared operator role is treated as authentication or authorization.
test_cases.expected_result: Gate derives authenticated subject independently; UI text remains informational.

test_cases.attack_vector: declared_operator.role is OPERATOR while caller credential lacks operator role.
test_cases.expected_result: Policy rejects before ledger allocation or worker dispatch.

test_cases.attack_vector: Wrong audience, wrong peer, expired token or cert, or mismatched authenticated principal.
test_cases.expected_result: Authentication/policy rejects before worker dispatch and redacts sensitive details.

test_cases.attack_vector: checkpoint_coordinates at 4097 items, int outside signed 32-bit range, huge timeout, or large strings.
test_cases.expected_result: Schema/ingress rejects before worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Valid schema but quota, concurrency, or memory grant would exceed policy.
test_cases.expected_result: Typed quota rejection; no worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Operation times out, is cancelled, or fails after partial work.
test_cases.expected_result: Terminal status is failed, timed out, or cancelled; no SUCCESS/COMPLETED receipt.

test_cases.attack_vector: Intent catalog_backend_ref differs from frozen catalog source.backend_ref or catalog lacks plugin/dataset pair.
test_cases.expected_result: Catalog parity/capability matrix rejects before worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Valid IDs but operation/scope unsupported by capability matrix, such as TRAIN_TICKET outside PLUGIN_BOUNDARY.
test_cases.expected_result: Typed policy/capability rejection before worker start.

test_cases.attack_vector: Receipt reuses another intent/admission/execution or omits admission_id, admission_digest, execution_id, producer_commit, or catalog ref.
test_cases.expected_result: Receipt lineage validation rejects; UI does not display as bound receipt.

test_cases.attack_vector: Local PLUGIN_BOUNDARY execution includes STAGE_C_REAL_DRQ1, round_id, state_root, wal_sequence, or QC-looking fields.
test_cases.expected_result: Worker/UI rejects or marks invalid; no consensus wording or authority.

test_cases.attack_vector: Audit/status errors include bearer tokens, private dataset payloads, Ed25519 private key material, or raw model data.
test_cases.expected_result: Redaction tests reject unsafe audit output; no secrets committed.
